project_id: Big League Smart Contract Audit Report - QuillAudits

violation_target.vulnerability_type: Denial of Service via Liquidity Addition

preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the token (BGLG) to initiate transfer
Contract must have accumulated fee tokens in its balance (from previous transfers to pair)
Contract's token balance must be >= the swap threshold amount (totalSupply * 1/10000)

violation_target.exploit_hint: Trigger the _sellAndDistributeAccumulatedTKNFee() function by making a token transfer to the pair address (which sets _fee=true). This will cause the contract to attempt to add liquidity via router.addLiquidityETH() with all BNB balance as BNBtoLiquidity. If the contract has insufficient BNB balance compared to the token amount for liquidity (TKNtoLiquidity), the transaction will revert due to the PancakeSwap router's validation, causing a denial of service for all subsequent transfers to the pair until the contract receives sufficient BNB or the liquidity fee is disabled.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract's _sellAndDistributeAccumulatedTKNFee() function attempts to add liquidity using all BNB balance (BNBtoLiquidity = address(this).balance). If the contract has insufficient BNB compared to the token amount for liquidity, the PancakeSwap router will revert, causing a denial of service for all subsequent transfers to the pair.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Acquire BGLG tokens. 2. Ensure contract accumulates fee tokens by making transfers. 3. Verify contract has minimal BNB balance. 4. Trigger transfer to pair to invoke the vulnerable function, causing revert in addLiquidityETH.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use deal() to give attacker BGLG tokens. 2. Make several transfers to accumulate fees in contract. 3. Check contract's BNB balance is low. 4. Transfer to pair address to trigger _sellAndDistributeAccumulatedTKNFee(). 5. The function will swap tokens for BNB (getting minimal BNB due to low liquidity), then revert in addLiquidityETH.
